package.description: A lightweight, native C++ desktop widget for Windows that displays the current Nepali (Bikram Sambat) date.

en-US.description: A lightweight, native C++ desktop widget for Windows that displays the current Nepali (Bikram Sambat) date.
en-US.longDescription:
A lightweight, native C++ desktop widget for Windows that beautifully displays the current Nepali (Bikram Sambat) date directly on your desktop.
Features include automatic Windows Light/Dark theme detection, built-in update checker via GitHub Releases API, toggleable day-of-week display,
frameless transparent design with GDI+ alpha blending, smart fullscreen auto-hide, DPI awareness for 4K monitors, and ultra-efficient
resource usage with near-zero CPU consumption.
en-US.name: Nepali Date Widget
